title: Slacking.biz — SEC Financial Data + US Economics + Demographics
description: 28 MCP tools: SEC financials, FRED economics, Census demographics.
summary: 28 MCP tools: SEC financials, FRED economics, Census demographics.
offersHint: 28 MCP tools: SEC financials, FRED economics, Census demographics. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://slacking.biz/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_company_health
toolsPreview.description: Get a company's overall financial health score (A-F grade) including summary metrics

toolsPreview.name: get_trends
toolsPreview.description: Get financial trends over time for a company — revenue, profit, margins across reporting periods

toolsPreview.name: industry_comparison
toolsPreview.description: Compare a company's financial metrics against its industry averages

toolsPreview.name: get_revenue_segments
toolsPreview.description: Get revenue breakdown by product/service segments for a company

toolsPreview.name: get_income_statement
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed income statement for a company (revenue, expenses, earnings per share)

toolsPreview.name: get_balance_sheet
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed balance sheet for a company (assets, liabilities, equity)

toolsPreview.name: get_cash_flow
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed cash flow statement for a company (operating, investing, financing)

toolsPreview.name: get_all_financial_data
toolsPreview.description: Get all financial data (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) in one call

toolsPreview.name: get_company_profile
toolsPreview.description: Get company profile — sector, industry, employees, description, market cap

toolsPreview.name: get_filing_types
toolsPreview.description: Get filing types available for a company (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, etc.)

toolsPreview.name: search_filings
toolsPreview.description: Search filings for a company — search by form type, date range, keywords. Use get_filing_types first to see what's available.

toolsPreview.name: get_insider_trades
toolsPreview.description: Get recent insider trading activity for a company (Form 4 filings)

toolsPreview.name: get_sentiment
toolsPreview.description: Get sentiment analysis from SEC filings for a company — positive/negative/neutral signals from 10-K/10-Q reports

toolsPreview.name: compare_companies
toolsPreview.description: Compare financial metrics across multiple companies side by side

toolsPreview.name: screen_companies
toolsPreview.description: Screen companies by financial criteria (high growth, low debt, profitable, high margin, cash rich, undervalued)

toolsPreview.name: batch_query
toolsPreview.description: Batch query multiple tickers at once for efficiency

toolsPreview.name: fx_get_rates
toolsPreview.description: Get live exchange rates for any currency. Sources: European Central Bank + 84 central banks, 201 currencies. No API key needed — free for commercial use.

toolsPreview.name: fx_get_pair_rate
toolsPreview.description: Get the exchange rate between any two currencies. Sources: ECB + 84 central banks. Free for commercial use.

toolsPreview.name: fx_convert
toolsPreview.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another at current exchange rates. Sources: ECB + 84 central banks. Free for commercial use.

toolsPreview.name: fx_list_currencies
toolsPreview.description: List all 31 available currency codes and names for foreign exchange queries. Covers USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, and more.

toolsPreview.name: get_gdp
toolsPreview.description: Get latest US GDP data from FRED

toolsPreview.name: search_scholarly
toolsPreview.description: Search scholarly research works (OpenAlex, keyless) — titles, authors, year, citation counts

toolsPreview.name: get_labor_series
toolsPreview.description: Get BLS labor market series (keyless) — unemployment rate default (LNS14000000)

toolsPreview.name: get_air_quality
toolsPreview.description: Get air quality data (OpenAQ) — PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2 for a city

toolsPreview.name: get_bea_gdp
toolsPreview.description: Get US GDP from BEA (NIPA accounts)

toolsPreview.name: get_inflation
toolsPreview.description: Get latest CPI/inflation data from FRED

toolsPreview.name: get_rates
toolsPreview.description: Get latest Fed funds rate, mortgage rates, and treasury yields from FRED

toolsPreview.name: get_employment
toolsPreview.description: Get latest unemployment rate and jobless claims from FRED

toolsPreview.name: get_housing
toolsPreview.description: Get latest housing starts and existing home sales data from FRED

toolsPreview.name: get_econ_summary
toolsPreview.description: Get all key economic indicators (GDP, CPI, rates, employment, housing) in one call from FRED

toolsPreview.name: get_zip_demographics
toolsPreview.description: Get demographics for a ZIP code (population, income, age, housing, education) from the US Census Bureau

toolsPreview.name: get_county_demographics
toolsPreview.description: Get county-level demographics data by FIPS code from the US Census Bureau

toolsPreview.name: treasury_debt
toolsPreview.description: Get US federal debt to the penny — total public debt outstanding, debt held by the public, intragovernmental holdings. Source: US Treasury Fiscal Data (free, unrestricted, commercial use allowed).

toolsPreview.name: treasury_fx_rates
toolsPreview.description: Get official US Treasury reporting rates of exchange — daily official FX rates for 100+ currencies. Source: US Treasury Fiscal Data (free, unrestricted).

toolsPreview.name: treasury_interest_rates
toolsPreview.description: Get US Treasury average interest rates by security type (T-bills, notes, bonds). Source: US Treasury Fiscal Data (free, unrestricted).

toolsPreview.name: eurostat_gdp
toolsPreview.description: Get Eurostat GDP (annual, million EUR, current prices) for an EU country or aggregate (DE, FR, IT, EU27_2020, EA20). Source: Eurostat dissemination API (free of charge, commercial use with attribution).

toolsPreview.name: eurostat_inflation
toolsPreview.description: Get Eurostat HICP inflation — annual rate of change (%) for an EU country (DE, FR, IT, EU27_2020, EA20). Source: Eurostat dissemination API.

toolsPreview.name: eurostat_unemployment
toolsPreview.description: Get Eurostat unemployment rate (%) — monthly, seasonally adjusted, age 15-74, for an EU country (DE, FR, IT, EU27_2020, EA20). Source: Eurostat dissemination API.

toolsPreview.name: oecd_leading_indicators
toolsPreview.description: Get OECD Composite Leading Indicators (CLI, amplitude-adjusted) for an OECD country (USA, DEU, JPN, GBR, etc.). Source: OECD Data Explorer (openly reusable with attribution, no key).

toolsPreview.name: nws_forecast
toolsPreview.description: Get official NWS weather forecast (7-day periods: temperature, wind, short/detailed forecast) for a latitude/longitude. Source: NOAA National Weather Service (free for any purpose).

toolsPreview.name: nws_alerts
toolsPreview.description: Get active NWS weather alerts (watches, warnings, advisories) for a US state (e.g. FL, CA, TX). Source: NOAA National Weather Service (free for any purpose).

toolsPreview.name: fda_drug_labels
toolsPreview.description: Search FDA drug labels by brand/generic name or ingredient. Source: openFDA (public-domain US FDA data). Disclaimer: not validated for clinical/production use.

toolsPreview.name: fda_recalls
toolsPreview.description: Get recent FDA drug enforcement recalls (product, reason, classification, status, company). Source: openFDA (public-domain US FDA data).

toolsPreview.name: health_drug_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Look up an FDA drug label by NDC or brand/generic name — active ingredients, purpose, indications, warnings, dosage, manufacturer. Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA), public data. Attribution: Data provided by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (openFDA).

toolsPreview.name: health_drug_ndc
toolsPreview.description: Look up an FDA drug label by National Drug Code (NDC) — active ingredients, purpose, indications, warnings, manufacturer. Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA), public data.

toolsPreview.name: health_drug_search
toolsPreview.description: Search FDA drug labels by brand name, generic name, or active ingredient — returns brand, generic, manufacturer, purpose, and indications. Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA), public data.

toolsPreview.name: health_adverse_events
toolsPreview.description: FAERS adverse event reports for a drug by brand/generic name — report id, seriousness, reactions, outcomes. Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA) FAERS, public data.

toolsPreview.name: health_adverse_events_by_ndc
toolsPreview.description: FAERS adverse event reports for a drug by NDC code — report id, seriousness, reactions, outcomes. Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA) FAERS, public data.

toolsPreview.name: health_recalls
toolsPreview.description: FDA enforcement recalls (drugs, devices, food) — search by product keyword, or most recent when no query. Returns product, reason, classification, status, company. Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA), public data.

toolsPreview.name: health_recalls_by_company
toolsPreview.description: FDA enforcement recalls for a specific recalling firm/company — product, reason, classification, status. Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA), public data.

toolsPreview.name: health_device_510k
toolsPreview.description: Look up an FDA 510(k) premarket device clearance by K number — device name, applicant, decision, decision date, product code. Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA), public data.

toolsPreview.name: health_summary
toolsPreview.description: Health data API overview — endpoint list, most recent FDA recall, and live sample counts (aspirin adverse events + labels). Source: openFDA (U.S. FDA), public data.

toolsPreview.name: datausa_population
toolsPreview.description: Get US population by geography (Nation/State/County/Place) from Data USA API (curated Census ACS data). No key required.

toolsPreview.name: datausa_income
toolsPreview.description: Get US median household income by geography (Nation/State/County/Place) from Data USA API (curated Census ACS data). No key required.

toolsPreview.name: usgs_earthquakes
toolsPreview.description: Get recent earthquakes worldwide with magnitude, location, depth, and tsunami flag. Source: USGS FDSN Event Web Service (public-domain, unlimited, no key).

toolsPreview.name: usaspending_budget
toolsPreview.description: Get total US federal budgetary resources (spending authority) by fiscal year and period. Source: USAspending.gov API (US government open data, no key).

toolsPreview.name: usaspending_awards
toolsPreview.description: Search US federal contract/grant awards by keyword — award ID, recipient, amount, awarding agency. Source: USAspending.gov API (no key).

toolsPreview.name: imf_indicator
toolsPreview.description: Get IMF World Economic Outlook indicator for a country — GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, debt, etc. Source: IMF DataMapper API (free to use/redistribute with attribution, no key).

toolsPreview.name: edgar_fulltext_search
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across ALL SEC EDGAR filings (EFTS) — find filings mentioning a keyword/phrase across companies. Extends the existing per-company SEC integration with cross-company filing search. Source: SEC EDGAR full-text search (public-domain, no key).

toolsPreview.name: nonprofit_990_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Get IRS Form 990 financial data for a US nonprofit by EIN — revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, officer compensation, contributions, and program revenue from the latest 990/990-EZ/990-PF filing, plus 5-year filing history. Source: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (public-domain IRS 990 XML).
